nom: d'Alba Piedmont Double Serum All In One Multi Balm Stick

avis.texte: Im so glad i took a chance and bought this. I saw someone recommend this for the under eye before makeup to prevent concealer sitting on dry spots, and it worked perfectly! I make sure to give the product a gew minutes to settle, and then go about starting my makeup. I have even started using it on other parts of my face where i can get dry spots/patchiness when doing my makeup. Such a game changer. You should absolutely try this out!!

I've tried different hydrating sticks from a few of brands and none of them are as hydrating as this one. I use this in my under eye and any dry areas around my face. absolutely great product, please try this because it won't disappoint.

I love how convenient and easy this balm stick is to use. It glides on smoothly and instantly makes my skin feel more hydrated and look fresh and dewy. I especially like using it around my under-eyes, smile lines, and any areas that feel dry. It gives a beautiful glow without feeling too heavy, and the stick format makes it perfect for keeping in my bag for quick touch-ups throughout the day.

I've been loving this balm! It melts into the skin, removes makeup effortlessly, and leaves my face feeling clean, soft, and hydrated without any greasy residue. A little goes a long way, and it's perfect for my sensitive skin. Highly recommend!

I've been using the d'Alba Multi Balm for a while now, and I genuinely love it! 🤍 It instantly hydrates dry areas, gives my skin a healthy glow, and works perfectly both under and over makeup. Such an easy product to keep in my bag for quick touch-ups throughout the day. ✨

I've been using the d'Alba Multi Balm for a while now, and I genuinely love it! 🤍 It instantly hydrates dry areas, gives my skin a healthy glow, and works perfectly both under and over makeup. Such an easy product to keep in my bag for quick touch-ups throughout the day. ✨

it's become a favorite in my makeup routine. It feels lightweight and nourishing without leaving my skin greasy, and I especially like applying it to my under-eyes and other dry areas before makeup. My concealer goes on more smoothly, and my makeup looks fresher and more hydrated throughout the day. I also appreciate how convenient it is for quick touch-ups when my skin starts to feel dry. If you struggle with makeup looking cakey or settling into fine lines, this balm is definitely worth trying.

I've been using the d'Alba Multi Balm on my under-eyes and smile lines before applying concealer, and it makes a noticeable difference. It adds just the right amount of hydration, so my concealer goes on smoother and looks less creasy throughout the day. It's lightweight, easy to apply, and has become a staple in my makeup prep routine.

༺The outer balm (shea, jojoba, macadamia oils) seals and softens, while the inner core carries the brightening actives. Vitamin C (ascorbic acid) + glutathione are the brightening pair, vitamin C works on dullness and evens tone, glutathione supports it from a different angle. ༺Trufferol (white truffle + vitamin E) is the antioxidant core, defending against the environmental stress that dulls and ages skin while supporting elasticity. Ceramide NP reinforces the moisture barrier, HA binds hydration, so dry patches soften instead of just looking glossy. ༺The oil-rich base is what makes it multi-use, dry enough for elbows, cuticles and knees, gentle enough for cheeks and high points, which is why it works head to toe. ༺Best for dry, dull, mature, or dehydrated skin, targeted dry patches, and a portable glow refresh over makeup.

I am obsessed with this d'Alba Multibalm stick, it's an emotional support tool for me. I apply when I wake up after the first spray serum. Then apply before makeup, after makeup, over skincare and of pure before I hit the pillow at night. It helps hydrate my fine lines to make them less visible. And the glow is insane

avis.titre: Differant but in a good way
avis.texte: This balm is really convenient. You only need a small amount. Run it across the cheeks forhead neck ect a dab covers the entire area. Settles and helps with elasticity I've noticed changes over the last month. I'd recommend this for sure.

avis.titre: I would buy this product  again
avis.texte: Softens the eye area to make application of concealer. Love this product.

This balm is really nice for quick touch-ups! It adds a subtle glow and smooths dry areas, especially around the eyes or smile lines. The texture melts in easily and isn't overly greasy. I've noticed my skin texture has improved over the past few weeks since using it. Overall, it's great for on-the-go glow and dryness fixes!

avis.titre: Good Concept, Not the Right Texture
avis.texte: The d'alba Double Serum Multi Balm didn't work well for me. While I like the idea of a convenient, on-the-go balm, the texture felt too greasy and left a sticky residue on my skin. It didn't absorb the way I expected, and I didn't find it suitable for daytime use or under makeup. Unfortunately, this one just wasn't a good fit for my preferences.
Its smooth and hydrate well for mature and dry skin and you can put it in bag and use anytime.

I enjoy products that are convenient to use, I kept this at my bedside table for easy night time application. I admit I'm not the best when it comes to remembering my night routine but with this I can equally apply before bed and not worry about the night air over drying me. I do have sensitive dry skin so I need lots of moisture through out the day, I have noticed a glowy effect on my skin and my dark spots fading around the areas I use this.
Finally something that helps my Uber dry skin hold some moisture and my concealer not look like crap. Love it.

Smells nice and feels light on my skin. I like the push application method. I used it multiple ways - under moisturizer and on top of it. I didn't notice any significant effects but I did see it dried out my skin a touch - it started to flake. Perhaps this is a good thing and new skin is resurfacing. I will continue to use this but I cannot say I would recommend to a friend based on my experience so far.

avis.titre: May or not be suited for people with oily skin
avis.texte: I think this is a good product for those who do not have oily skin. It does feel nice on one's skin but it was a little sticky for me. I also have oily skin so probably not the best pairing.
Convenient for travel or throwing in your purse. The balm is hydrating and leaves my skin glowy.

I found this product to be useful and true to being "all in one". Using it during the day provided a feeling of being moisturized and made my face look dewy not oily. I found it be a great base for my makeup as well. Not sure how sanitary using this would be unless it is used right after washing your face. So retouching during the day may not recommended. This product would be great for travel, no need to pack too many products.
I really like this balm. It goes on like aquaphor and is very hydrating to the skin. But it's heavy, so I really only use it before bed and sleep with it on.

avis.titre: My skin feels a decade younger!
avis.texte: I live in the Northeastern US and winter here can wreak havoc on my skin. Between brutal windburn from being outside shoveling out my driveway to bone-dry forced heat air, I spend all winter wishing I could jump in a tub of lotion. I got this is February and OMG! Within three days, my face felt soft and plump. By two weeks, it felt a full decade younger. Why is it sold out? I need more!

avis.titre: A New Favorite for Dry Skin
avis.texte: I had never tried a skincare product in a stick form like this before, and I have to say, I love it. It's incredibly easy to use and so practical, especially for quick touch-ups throughout the day. I was given this product as a free sample to review, and I ended up finishing the entire stick, which I almost never do with samples. At first, I was worried it might feel greasy, but it actually absorbs really nicely into the skin. I started using it when I was dealing with very dry, cracked skin on my forehead from cold, dry weather. It had gotten so bad that my dryness was showing through my makeup and making it difficult to apply smoothly. Once I started using this multi-balm, the dryness became much less noticeable almost immediately. After about a week of consistent use, my skin felt healed and smooth again. I have mature skin, and I also noticed a slight plumpness in my face, which was a really nice bonus. It has a subtle citrusy scent that feels fresh but not overpowering. I definitely recommend this balm, especially if you struggle with dry patches or want something convenient and effective. After two weeks, I started pairing it with the d'Alba Refresh Aqua Serum, and I loved the results even more.

This balm leaves your skin very dewy and hydrated. It goes on seamlessly and blends into your skin easily. It is perfect your highlighting your cheek bones or just adding an overall glow to your skin. It did feel a little bit thick for the under eye area and as I struggle with milia under my eyes, I didn't use it in that area enough to speak to the results of extended use. Overall, it is a nice product!

It just me or does everyone have the same problem. I have bought this product twice. Same problem. I threw away the first one because I thought i got a bad one. Purchased again and it does the same thing every time I apply it it breaks in to hard crumbs.
This is a unique product, I've never used something like this before but it's great to use in a rush in the morning because it's cuts down your routine and gets the job done

I have fine lines under my eyes and use this under my eyes before I put my makeup on and it works great. My foundation lays on better and there is no creasing. I love the application and texture of the product.
The product gave me a nice glow and great moisture all over my face. I especially liked the way the product felt around my under eyes.
This balm is incredibly convenient and nourishing. It leaves my skin soft, hydrated, and glowing, while helping smooth fine lines throughout the day.
I actually really like to use this on my hands to make them look more youthful and then my frown lines. Makes them look shiny but once it absorbs in looks great
Really love this balm and it's especially great around my eyes. It definitely gives that glowing skin we are all looking for. I will repurchase the d'alba in the future. Highly recommend

avis.titre: Beautiful serum in a fun form
avis.texte: I was given this product for free in exchange for my honest review. This dual serum is in a stick form which is great to take with you and not fear it spilling. Super moisturizing. I have combination skin, and it's great. I do think it might be too much for the oilier skin type!

This is a nice serum that I've been using daily and for skin prep before applying makeup. I feel that it works well with other product. More importantly, I feel like it has been a great transitional product from winter to spring as the climate has been changing. I feel like this product keeps my combination skin at bay.

This balm and serum combo is great! I apply it after I wash my face in the morning. It isn't sticky and glides on smooth. It absorbs pretty fast and doesn't affect my makeup or make my face greasier. It's great for those dry spots too.

This is my first time trying a hydrating product in a balm form for skin, and I love how easy and convenient it is! I've been having issues with my skin drying out during the day, and it's so easy to have in my purse and quickly glide over skin that's feeling dry. I didn't like using it with any foundation, because it would look really strange upon application, but on naked skin it's great!

I really wanted to love this for my under eyes. Dark circles, fine lines. I really wanted to see if it helped my makeup lay nicely. Unfortunately, it's a little sticky so my makeup broke up when placed on top of it. Seemed no matter how much dry time I gave it, I encountered the same issue. However, my solution was to use it at night, not under any makeup. It is in a convenient twist up stick which makes application nice and simple.
I love how easy it is to apply and it adds such a beautiful glow to my face. I also feel like it hydrates my dry patches, so I always apply this before SPF and makeup.
I received this product in exchange for my review. This balm leaves my skin feeling smooth. I use it before my makeup and my foundations glides on so well! Would definitely recommend!
This is the best product to use on my eyelids and under my eyes before applying makeup. I just do one swipe after washing my face. I will continue to buy this.

I received this in exchange for a review. I have pretty dry skin and live in a dry climate - I liked this balm, it felt mild and hydrating. Nothing groundbreaking to be honest but it worked well for me. My face felt moisturized.

This is such a convenient and easy product to use! I have been using it under my eyes for a brightening effect and after about a month of using it I can say that it has made a difference! Its really lovely.

I love this balm! It's so hydrating for the under eyes and eyelids . I use it in the morning and night time. I also use it before applying my makeup as well. Just swipe it and it absorbs well into the skin

I fell for the hype & bought this. Used it every morning. It feels great, it instantly melts into a serum and felt very moisturizing. After 1-2 weeks though, I noticed my undereye area looked wrinkly and saggy. I decided not to use this balm stick for a few days. My undereye area improved & now looks like it did before I started using this balm stick. This product didn't do anything for the rest of my face. The balm stick is almost empty anyways, but I definitely will not repurchase. If you're noticing your skin is looking worse, it may be this product.

avis.titre: I would by this product again
avis.texte: Perfect under eye hydration the concealer goes smoothly with no caking

The d'Alba Double Serum All‑In‑One Multi Balm is a surprisingly versatile skincare essential that lives up to its name. The balm has a smooth, lightweight texture that melts effortlessly into the skin, delivering instant moisture and nourishment without feeling greasy or heavy. I love how convenient this product is—it works beautifully on dry areas like under the eyes, around the nose, lips, and even cuticles. It's also great for adding a subtle, healthy glow to the high points of the face or refreshing skin throughout the day. The dual‑serum formula gives the skin a nourished, plump look while helping smooth fine lines and dryness. The finish is dewy but controlled, making it suitable both under makeup and on bare skin. The packaging is sleek and portable, which makes it easy to keep in a bag for quick touch‑ups. Like other d'Alba products, the quality feels luxurious and well thought out.

This one surprised me in a good way. It's super convenient — I just swipe it on dry areas like around my nose, lips, or even under my eyes. It gives instant hydration and a soft glow without feeling greasy. I like that it's mess-free and easy to use throughout the day. It's one of those products you don't realize you need until you start using it. Perfect for quick touch-upS

I like to use it for undereyes area, or anywhere I have dry areas. I cannot attest to its brightening effect (from vit c) just yet as I have only use it for the a couple weeks. But so far it works great on my skin and does not break me out.

I use this balm on dry spots, lips, and even as a quick glow booster. It's super moisturizing without feeling greasy and really convenient to carry around. My only minor gripe is it's small, so it runs out faster than you'd expect, but overall it's a must-have for on-the-go hydration.

This little stick is great to stick in your vanity bag when traveling because it his a bunch of different spots and takes up barely any space. The vitamin C and vegan collagen helps keep my skin hydrated and firm.

I've never seen serum as a balm or in a stick form before, but I found it convenient to use. It does give a nice sheen when I put it on my face, so I like to use this at night or when I'm working from home. The serum absorbs into the skin well, and I like to use it where my skin feels dry, like around my eyes, and on my lips. I also use it where I have wrinkles forming on my face. The box says the serum hydrates and firms the skin for wrinkle improvement, brightening, and moisturizing. I'm seeing improvements on my skin, and I'm looking forward to long term results.

D'alba sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program. As for my opinion, this product feels very nourishing on the skin. It's a light weight finish without leaving the skin feeling sticky.

I have been using the double serum multi balm for several weeks as the last step in my nightly skin care routine. This balm glides on smoothly and really helps to seal in my serums and moisturizers. It blends an absorbs easily into my skin, leaving my skin feeling smooth and providing a nice glow, without feeling greasy.

avis.titre: Would repurchase, a mainstay in my bag
avis.texte: This hydrating balm stick is super easy to use and actually works. It glides on smoothly and gives instant moisture without feeling greasy. I love that it lasts for hours and works on lips, dry spots, and even cuticles. It's great for on-the-go and layers well with makeup too. Definitely a go-to if you want quick, no-mess hydration.

avis.titre: Great all in one balm for on the go
avis.texte: This is the perfect size to travel with and do touch up as needed. This balm hydrates my skin and gives me back some elasticity and brightening . It is certifies vegan and glides in so smooth and doesn't leave a stickiness behind . Love that it has both shea butter and vitamin C. It has a beautiful fragrance too. It works so well especially around the eyes to help plump away the fine lines leaving a beautiful palate for your concealer and eye makeup.
I recieved this item for free in exchange for an honest review and I must say I LOVE it. I keep this in my bag and use it throughout the day whenever my face feels a little dry. Perfect travel size

This White Truffle Double Serum All-In-One Multi Balm is a dual-layer, vegan-certified, portable stick that provides instant hydration. Improved elasticity and over hydration of face. There was also no sticky residue to deal with after application. I would highly recommend this product, it's not just a new trend.

This balm is so convenient! It's basically skincare on the go. I swipe it on when my skin feels dry and it instantly hydrates my dry areas. It's not greasy, just gives my skin a nice sheen. I've even used it over makeup and it doesn't mess anything up. Super easy to toss in your purse and do a quick refresh. I also use it at night around my eyes after I have washed my face and prepped my skin to help lock in the moisture. I really like it and would definitely recommend it!

avis.titre: A great all natural addition to my routine
avis.texte: I love this convenient balm. I use it on my face, including lips and eyelids, for a dose of moisturize that soothes and plumps. It absorbs well and allows my makeup to go on smoothly.

I got this complimentary from d'Alba. This multi balm is convenient to have! I use it to treat my dark spots and dry spots. I did notice my spots getting lighter and my skin looking brighter. I like that it's a compact stick, so it's easy to apply and use. It's nice and feels lightweight. I would recommend!

I tend to get dry flaky patches on my face and this was incredibly useful. It's convenient and small, I bring it everywhere in my purse. It feels oily when you initially put it on, but after it dries it leaves your skin glowing and dry patches gone. This is by far the best face balm I've tried that works for my skin.

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. In the past I have only used liquid serums, but I actually prefer this stick version. It's so easy to apply and I can limit to specific areas or smooth over my whole face and neck. It leaves my skin feeling silky and has a slight dewey finish that looks great under my (light coverage) makeup. I live in a warm, dry climate and so may products feel greasy by the end of the day but this feels light all day. I would absolutely purchase this again!

I have really enjoyed putting this serum under my eyes both in the morning and at night. It goes on super smooth like butter and feels really good! I've noticed my wrinkles and crows feet look less noticeable and softer. I really love this product and it's fun to use.

This felt great on my skin. Very emollient and soft, it felt like it filled in the fine lines around my eyes. For transparency, I only used it when I wasn't wearing makeup as I think makeup wouldn't have adhered as it feels very slippy. Felt great in my skin in a work from home day! Not sure I'd buy this product as it does cell like a "must" in my routine.

I can't brag enough about this product. I have dedicated the last two years of my life to products that truly help my aging skin and this helps my under eyes appear plump and hydrated but also helps on dry spots around my face. I will continue to use this product. Love it so much.

So far so good! Ive been using it under my eyes for a nice burst of moisture. Its lightweight and gives a nice natural glow. I love that it comes in stick form and is super convenient for on the go. The formula is great and hasn't cause any negative reactions.
Great way to make serum more practical, this is an all in one serum in a stick that goes in very easily and absorbs to skin quick, easy to add and not forget about it !

I've been using the d'Alba Double Serum All In One Multi Balm Stick and really like how practical it is for everyday use. The balm texture feels nourishing and melts into the skin nicely, especially on dry spots like around my eyes and smile lines. It gives a natural, healthy sheen without looking oily, and it's super handy to keep in my bag for quick touch-ups during the day. It works well both on bare skin and over makeup, making it a simple but effective addition to my routine.
Love the way this feels and the hydrating glow! Even my husband asked what I was doing differently because of it!

This all in one balm leaves my skin feeling hydrated with no irritation. I was worried about skin sensitivity especially around the eyes, but thankfully no issues. It's a great balm that's easy to use and doesn't disappear quickly. Downside to that, don't apply shortly before bed if you're a side/stomach sleeper, or it gets all over the pillowcase.

avis.titre: Feels so good on my skin
avis.texte: This balm is amazing and it feels great when I apply it on my skin. My skin can get quite itchy, so this gives me good relief and moisturization. The neutral smell is a huge plus for me. The size of this balm is great to take when on the go.

D'Alba Double Serum All in One Multi Balm is a great serum for every day use. It hydrates skin and helps control wrinkles. It left my skin glowing. There were no uncomfortable side effects from using it. I received this for free for a honest review

My skin feels so nice every time I have used this serum. It goes on smooth, perfect under my moisturizer and it's been helping on the dry days we have been having. I will say I have noticed some pilling underneath my moisturizer but this was easily remedied by letting it dry before putting my moisturizer on.

I didn't expect to love the All In One Multi Balm, but it's actually super handy. It glides on smoothly, adds a subtle glow, and works great for quick touch-ups, especially around dry areas like under the eyes and around my mouth. It won't replace your moisturizer, but it's perfect for on-the-go hydration. Just as a side note it also has a light scent.

avis.titre: A staple in my night routine!
avis.texte: I added the d'Alba Double Serum All-In-One Balm to my nighttime routine about a month ago, and overall, I've had a pretty good experience with it. The texture is smooth and melts nicely into the skin. It feels nourishing without being too heavy, and I like how it leaves my skin feeling soft and hydrated by morning. It's an easy step to add at night, especially when I want something simple but still effective. That said, I didn't love the wording on the packaging that advertises "whitening." As a Black woman who loves her skin tone and culture, that language doesn't sit right with me. The only things I'm trying to whiten are my teeth and my white clothes. I understand it may be referring to brightening, but the choice of wording matters. Overall, I do like how the product performs, but I do think the branding could be more thoughtful and inclusive.
I've tried a few of their products and this one takes the cake! My new fav and a keeper in my routine skincare. Feels good and lightweight on my skin and also makes my face look so hydrated!

I can't say I see a huge benefit, but it's nice to put around my lips, eyes, forehead, and neck before applying moisturizer. I'll continue to use this product until it's gone, but may not repurchase. Not bad, but not great.
d'Alba Double Serum All In One Multi Balm feels so good on my skin. It helped alleviate the dry spot on my forehead.Yay! :)

avis.titre: Great way to deal in moisture
avis.texte: Ive been outside a lot more the past few weeks as the weather is getting warmer so I feel like I needed something heavier at night to lock in moisture. I use it in the problem areas around my nose and under my eyes. They seem to stay moisturizing all night into the mornings and leVe my skin feeling fresh. The balm itself isnt sticky but it is a little thick

Okay, I've been a little hesitant to jump on the k-beauty train, but this product is a bang for the buck beauty workhorse and it's no surprise that it's sold out on the website and hard to get! It is lightweight, nourishing, and delivers immediate improvement. I noticed improvement in skin brightening and hydration with just a few days of use.
Pretty good for a quick on the go moisturizer. Stick applicator makes it easy to slide on. Not too greasy and hydrates well

I have been testing the Double Serum All In One Multi Balm ever since I received it from d'Alba as part of an educational promotion. I love that it is versatile and compact, making it a great travel tool since it replaces so many other products in my bag. It's awesome for spot treating dry skin and wrinkles, but it also brightens up my dull and dark spots. The packaging and texture are a bit like a glue stick, bringing me major nostalgia! I also really enjoy how subtle the scent is. Overall this product is really effective and easy to use!

This multibalm by d'Alba has been great, since it's all in one. I use this balm at night most of the time. It's easy for me to use. I apply it to my cheeks, forehead, and finally to my neck. This is very moisturizing. It helps put the hydration back after I've washed my face. This also has a brightening core, with vitamin C which is seen in the middle of the tube. Plus this is a vegan beauty product which I look for. I will definitely keep using this nightly! I received this product free in exchange for my opinion.

avis.titre: d'Alba Double Serum All In One Multi Balm
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this! But unfortunately, it wasn't the best for my skin. I'm not sure if it was coincidence, but when I used it on my full face (after a small test patch for a few days), my skin had a small breakout. I might try it again, but I'm nervous after that first full face attempt. The formula also kind of feels like I'm putting chapstick on my face!
This product is amazing! Use it daily under my eyes and it keeps it hydrated all day!

I received this product complimentary for my honest review. This product applies very easily and smells nice as well. I apply this to my under eyes and anywhere else that wrinkles are starting to form. My eyes are already looking much more hydrated and I'm excited to see differences continue with prolonged use.
I love this balm it give hydration to my face over my makeup. It's effective and making my face look uniform and healthy. It helps brightens the dullness of my skin. I would buy this again!

avis.titre: My under eye bags are gone!!
avis.texte: This product moisturizes and lifts! My under eye area has never looked so healthy or felt so soft. This is my new favorite go-to eye product!
I've used a lot of balms in my time, but I actually like this one. I especially like it for my under eyes which gets really dry with age. It applies nicely under my eye makeup. I highly recommend.

avis.titre: Nourishing multi balm for dry areas, too rich for my face
avis.texte: I received this product for free through a testing program, but this review reflects my honest opinion. The d'Alba Double Serum All In One Multi Balm has a rich, silky texture and a pleasant scent, and I really enjoy the convenient stick format for on-the-go use—it's easy to keep in my bag and apply whenever I need it. On my face, however, it feels a bit too heavy and oily, so I don't like using it all over as a primary facial balm, especially since my skin can be prone to congestion. Where it really shines for me is as a targeted treatment for dry areas. I love using it on my hands, cuticles, and any dry patches on the body, and sometimes on my collarbones for a subtle glow; the formula melts nicely into the skin and gives those areas a soft, nourished look. Overall, I see it more as a luxurious multi-purpose balm stick for dry spots rather than an everyday face product for my skin type, but the portability and scent make it a nice little helper to have with me.

This is a miracle stick! I have been battling dry skin for so long and I can keep it at bay…kind of. But this balm stick has saved my skin! It's so easy to use that I just dab it on dry spots or use it all over. I highly recommend this product to everyone!
Lightweight balm that glides smoothly under my eyes. I have very dry under eyes and this product leaves my skin feeling more hydrated.

When first applying this product, it felt like I was putting on chapstick for my face. I didn't particularly like the feeling because it sits kind of heavy. If you use too much or in the wrong areas, you'll look oily/greasy. I could see this being useful to people who have dry or even cracked skin.

I've been using the d'Alba Double Serum All In One Multi Balm for a few days now and I honestly like how practical it is. The stick format makes it super easy to apply, especially on the go. I've mostly used it on dry areas like around my nose and lips, and it gives a nice, natural glow without feeling heavy or greasy. It feels lightweight but still moisturizing, which I really appreciate. Also, the scent is soft and not overwhelming. I like that I can just throw it in my bag and use it anytime during the day.
I used this serum as a moisturizer in my skin care routine and noticed it really hydrated my dry skin - very good product.

I received this from BzzAgent for my review. I love the idea that you can use this for your face, neck, eyes and lips. But I also don't like actually using this on my lips and then my face and vice versa. Like how I wouldn't use chapstick on my face. And while it doesn't feel as sticky as a chapstick would on my face, it still leaves too much product behind. I'll stick to using this as a lip balm.

I like the idea of this and it's super convenient for on the go. It glides on easily and gives a quick glow, but it can look very greasy .That said, it feels more like a surface level product. I also didn't notice any real improvement in my skin over time.

I am obsessed with this serum stick, I opened it instantly, it was love at first swipe. The scent is faint, and so rich at the same time. When I am out and about I apply this under my eyes, on my cheeks. Whe I am at home I cover my entire face. This gives so much moisture and glow. Over time this will soften my lines through hydration and the vitamin C will brighten my skin. I purchased one for my mom, she commented I use this stick 24/7 it must be good! So I gave her an early mother day gift. She loves it too!

I received this product for free from D'Alba in exchange for my honest review. I've been using this multi balm for close to two weeks and I'm loving it! It's my little glow-on-the-go secret—thanks to its sleek, portable design, I can carry it everywhere and use it anytime. Just a quick swipe and my skin looks hydrated, fresh, and radiant. Fine lines? Dry patches? This little stick handles it all. It's also been amazing under makeup—everything just glides on with an almost forgotten ease, leaving my skin looking smooth and dewy. And that glow… hello, who is she?! Also, can we talk about the scent? It's absolutely beautiful—light, luxurious, and so refreshing without being overpowering. It makes every application feel like a mini self-care moment. Definitely something I'll be buying again and again.

I've been using the d'Alba Double Serum Multi Balm, and it's a total game-changer for getting that instant "glass skin" glow without any stickiness. The dual-core formula with white truffle and collagen melts right in, making it perfect for smoothing out my fine lines on the go. It's super versatile since I can swipe it over my makeup for a dewy refresh or use it on my neck and lips for extra hydration.. I already added on my cart to buy more..
I love how easy and versatile this balm stick is. My skin absolutely lives the hydration that it provides. It's like a one stop shop for beauty products.

I haven't tried many other multi-balms, but the texture and application remind me a lot of a sunscreen stick. It glides on easily and makes it simple to target specific areas without any mess, which is great for quick, on-the-go use. One of the biggest benefits is how moisturizing it feels. It leaves skin looking nourished with a subtle glow, and the compact size makes it easy to carry and reapply throughout the day. It's also versatile enough to use on dry spots beyond just your face. That said, I did notice that it doesn't fully absorb into the skin. Because of that, it may feel too heavy, especially in hot or humid weather. I'd consider buying this again, particularly for cooler months when my skin needs more hydration and recommend it to those who have dry skin or want a convenient, travel-friendly balm, but those who prefer lightweight products or live in warmer climates might find it a bit too rich.

You can hydrate your skin and diminish fine lines with the swipe of a stick. I love the concept. You can apply before or after make-up application. While the products works well to erase lines and provide moisture it leaves a sticky residue which I didn't love. It reminds me of using lipgloss.

I liked that I could place the product directly where its needed. I have oily skin with small dry patches along my eyebrow. I was able to use directly on the dry spots without making my whole face too shiny. Fragrance it light and did not bother me. I used product along eye brows, under eyes, and on my lips.

Here's another product that is versatile and have recently incorporated as part of my skin care routine. The balm is very hydrating but light. It doesn't feel greasy on my skin and can be used all over face, neck and even lips. It's also very convenient since it's in stick form, I can leave it in my purse and use whenever I need it for touch ups during the day. I've been using it a lot on my neck it just feels very smooth and hydrated. I was lucky that I was given this product to try out otherwise I might have missed out on ever knowing about it. I've already bought a couple more so that I can have one at work and my gym bag.

I'm usually skeptical of any balms because I feel like they can dry out quickly. However, this double serum was quite nice and I love that I can use it on small, targeted areas quickly. It's a wee bit sticky, but I plan to use it mainly in the evening after I wash my face and allow it to sink in a bit to my trouble spots. May be best to use in the evening only. I probably won't use it on my lips and other areas combined, but I do love that it's easy to travel with and the price is right!

The d'Alba Double Serum All in One Multi balm includes ingredients to hydrate, brighten, smooth fine lines and wrinkles, firms skin and to moisturize and soften dry areas. This balm includes an antioxidant complex which includes white truffle from Piemonte, Italy that helps smooth fine lines and wrinkles and elasticity. Collagen helps improve firmness and elasticity. Ceramide NP to protect the moisture barrier and Vitamin C to brighten skin tone. I love the convenience of an all in one balm with multiple anti-aging ingredients. I haven't found the best way to apply just the right amount of serum, in the stick format. In my opinion it might be easier to apply from a jar which would make it easier to melt the perfect about of balm to ensure the application amount is what you need. That said, consistency of the serum balm is great.

I initially tried this product on my face but found it too much for my sensitive, oily skin. However I am using on the neck and chest area and am loving it. It's very moisturizing, not sticky and feels great on the skin.

D'Alba all in one multi-balm is a perfect addition to my skin care routine. I really like using the balm formula around the eyes, less touching with fingers. I believe this to be a gentler way to apply to delicate eye area. Easy to target specific areas of concern with a gentle slide of balm. Not at all greasy, soaks into the skin ,leaving a lovely glow. Applying after the d'Alba toner spray and before make up application preps the skin nicely for your primer base.

This multi-balm stick is a lifesaver for dry under-eyes and smile lines! It gives a natural glow without the sticky mess of other brands. Perfect for touch-ups over makeup to stop caking. Smells like citrus, and the 10g size is tiny but mighty.
I love this product! I use this right underneath my make up and it makes my skin so smooth. Its so easy to apply and will be a staple

avis.titre: I would buy this product. It has become part of my routine.
avis.texte: I really like the d'Alba Double Serum All in One Multi Balm! I think it is reducing the appearance of my crow's feet as well as other wrinkles on my face and neck. The serum glides on and absorbs-in easily. It is not greasy at all and it feels very hydrating. The scent is really nice--maybe slightly citrus-y. I received the serum from BuzzAgent in exchange for this review but I will look into buying it when I finish this one.

avis.titre: Not that great for oily skin
avis.texte: I have tried to use it multiple times. Everytime I put it on my face became even more oily. I wouldnt recommend this to anyone with oily skin or combination skin

avis.titre: A Convenient Glow Balm for On the Go Hydration
avis.texte: The balm is one of those products that quickly becomes a handbag essential. The stick format makes it super easy to apply without getting your hands messy, and it glides smoothly onto the skin without tugging. It gives an instant boost of hydration, especially on dry areas like under the eyes, around the mouth, or even on the neck. What I like most is the subtle glow it adds, it's not greasy, just a healthy, dewy finish that makes the skin look more refreshed. It works well both under and over makeup, which makes it perfect for quick touch ups during the day. The lightweight feel and convenience make it a great option if you want something simple but effective to keep your skin looking hydrated and radiant anytime, anywhere.

This serum is amazing! So easy to apply, I love that it is in an applicator stick. I love the way my skin feels and looks after I use it. It absorbs well and I can follow it with my moisturizer very quickly.
I love this serum- it's very hydrating and has a nice, silky texture. I've been using it every day under my moisturizer. It really melts into the skin and leaves it glowing.

avis.titre: A new essential for on the go hydration
avis.texte: This is my first experience with a serum in a balm and I love it! I took it with me on a recent trip and was able to keep hydrated during my long flight, and didn't have to worry about leakage in my bag. The texture is light but hydrating, and has a very subtle scent. It is now my go to serum for travels

avis.titre: Moisturizing balm good for daily use and traveling
avis.texte: The all in one multi balm is moisturizing with the double serum. I use it on my face as well as my body such as hand, and it does not feel greasy after application. The item is compact and I plan to bring it when traveling. It can easily fit in my cosmetic pouch or purse, so I can re-apply when being outside during the day. d'Alba provided free sample of this product for me to review. I would recommend it to people who are interested to try products which are made in Korea where they are known for quality cosmetic or skincare products.

*I got this product for free in exchange for my honest reviews* After using this product for a week here are my thoughts. I think this product has potential. I liked putting it on my cheeks, a little on my lips, a little under my eyes and I definitely found it to be hydrating in those areas. This may be more of a sensory preference but I felt that it left a bit of a residue feel. I think the stick is a little too big and would prefer it was smaller more like a chapstick size so putting it on my fingers ended up working better. I could definitely see using this with makeup to help it set more. It added some nice glow in some areas but I feel that the formula needs to be worked out a little better so it feels more smooth, less sticky.

Perfect for those days when you need to reapply hydration but don't want to use your dirty hands. I apply this to my face and neck to keep the hydration throughout the day. Keep this in your bag for all day use.

I love this stick serum! It's so unique since it's a balm with two products in one. I love prepping my skin before makeup with this and using it as a hydrating layer for my nighttime routine. It truly does smooth out all my fine lines and makes my makeup go on like butter.
